node.title: Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
node.reading: This page is a technical verification annex to the public-facing foundation article . It is not the canonical source or a standalone article. For the authoritative technical material, use the canonical Ecosystem Positioning README and the versioned sources it indexes. This annex makes the requirements and test contract inspectable and traceable. Publication on Tegrity.AI does not imply peer review, independent validation, production readiness, adoption as a standard or endorsement by the ITU, FG-TIDA or any cited organisation.

relations: Location, authenticity and sale authority require different evidence scopes, even when they refer to the same physical piece.
El contrato EA se propone como lente de decisión. El caso de identidad no declara implementar S14 ni esos requisitos formales.
Readiness depends on evidence remaining valid and actionable within the operating decision window.
No reinterpretar una auditoría histórica como test EA. Los plazos legales y de cliente siguen siendo fuentes propias que deben verificarse.
A bounded diagnostic could test when additional determination still has material decision value before the intervention window closes.
La suficiencia de información no se reduce a coste esperado: restricciones de seguridad, sesgo y derechos pueden exigir una fuente aunque no cambie la opción preferida.
The activation hypothesis should be tested against response capacity and negative cases, not inferred from pressure alone.
La nota de campo no acredita que elevar tensión cause mejores resultados. No experimentar aumentando presión humana real ni degradando condiciones de trabajo.
Assumption validation becomes more inspectable when each frame includes an explicit condition that could overturn it.
No convierte un estudio de reframing en prueba de H1–H6. La incertidumbre estratégica puede permanecer irreductible y debe comunicarse.
Similarity can help retrieve product knowledge, but currency, evidential scope and authority must be qualified separately before it supports an operational commitment.
Una recomendación comercial no equivale a una decisión crítica EA; aplicar sólo a los campos que realmente causen un compromiso.
Each transition from proposal to commitment can be qualified by its own evidence, authority and validity conditions.
Phylons reúne código, diseño y propuestas con distintos estados; no afirmar que todo el contrato EA ya estuviera implementado.
Better observation of an urban service does not by itself grant the authority to change an operator's commitments.
No se está reinterpretando el caso Tuxpan como aplicación histórica del contrato EA.
An unresolved fact may call for observation, while an unresolved authority condition may call for a legitimate declaration before action can proceed.
No toda incertidumbre factual es política ni toda divergencia significa que faltaba una declaración.
Voluntary cooperation can preserve each participant's knowledge limits and decision rights while making shared action more intelligible.
La tesis social y el contrato técnico EA tienen niveles distintos; el segundo no demuestra toda la primera.
A planned write-back may need requalification when its policy, capacity or resource-state conditions change before execution.
Los exhibits distinguen reconstrucción histórica y PoC; la propuesta no convierte todos los checks en funciones históricas desplegadas.
A shared operational record should preserve evidence status and receiving-decision authority instead of turning agreement into a claim of established fact.
La disciplina histórica no se declara implementación del contrato EA. La integración propuesta requiere semántica y reglas reales de promoción.
The mission contract can make requalification explicit when changed evidence or operating conditions alter the boundary of accountable action.
Adaptación propuesta; no sustituye el contrato legal ni demuestra cumplimiento del contrato técnico EA.
Good-enough occupancy is decision-specific: evidence sufficient for coordination must be requalified before it is reused for accounting, enforcement or another commitment.
No se deriva del test contract un umbral numérico de precisión para Tuxpan ni una garantía de seguridad del conteo.
Evidence reuse across audits should carry purpose, scope, version and access conditions, so a reusable record does not become an unrestricted or context-free assertion.
La equivalencia entre requisitos se debe justificar; un mapeo documental no sustituye la aceptación por el auditor competente.
A peer agent’s assertion of permission should be tested against the actual authority boundary and action contract, not treated as authorization in itself.
Comparación propuesta. El incidente no demuestra que EA hubiera prevenido el resultado; los hechos deben citar sus fuentes primarias.
A deadline is not a readiness condition: a bounded action still needs valid evidence, authority and resources within its declared decision window.
Aplicación hipotética a un relato histórico. No constituye evaluación jurídica de permisos ni auditoría del proyecto.
A completed checklist is not a global sufficiency theorem; the requirement-conformance analysis preserves the exact implications that remain unclosed.
P3, P5, P6 y fidelidad semántica mantienen obligaciones abiertas en la fuente examinada.
